🚀 Galaga

Galaga challenges you to shoot down waves of alien invaders that swoop in formation. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Use left/right arrows to move your ship.
  2. Press Space to fire — hold for rapid fire if available.
  3. Shoot enemies as they dive toward you in formation.
  4. Destroy the commander alien to get bonus points.
  5. Watch for the tractor beam — shoot the enemy before they capture you.
